platform: Niche Platforms (Amazon MX Player, Lionsgate Play, MUBI, Crunchyroll)
market_share_2026: Specialized & AVOD-to-SVOD niche segment (~6% aggregate SVOD share)

primary_methods.amazon_mx_player: Internal Mobile REST API (`androidapi.mxplay.com/v1/detail/`) or Web Detail API (`api.mxplay.com/v1/web/detail/video`)
primary_methods.crunchyroll: yt-dlp built-in extractor & Unofficial Crunchyroll API with client_credentials grant
primary_methods.mubi: Direct web scraping of `mubi.com/films` + public RSS feeds

anti_bot_and_cdn: MX Player: Low protection for catalog JSON. Crunchyroll: Cloudflare protection + OAuth2. MUBI: Moderate web security. Lionsgate Play: High DRM & web shielding.
dump_vs_sync: 1-Time Dump: Use MX Player API to dump series/movie lists. Use aggregators for Lionsgate Play. Continuous Sync: Weekly delta checks.
tos_and_legal_risk: Low risk for MX Player and public web listings.

mx_player_sample.title: My Girlfriend Is An Alien (Hindi Dubbed)
